v.title: Euro 2028 Qualifying Draw Set for 12 March – What Barcelona Needs to Know
v.excerpt: Euro 2028 qualifying draw set for March 12 – Barcelona’s squad and strategy may shift based on the new groupings.
v.body:
## Quick take
The Euro 2028 qualifying draw is scheduled for 12 March 2025. All 55 UEFA members will be sorted into seven groups, and the top two from each will advance to the 2028 finals.

## What happened
BBC Sport’s “Ask Me Anything” team confirmed the draw date, noting that the event will take place at the UEFA headquarters in Nyon, Switzerland. The draw will be streamed live, allowing fans worldwide to see the groupings as they unfold.

The announcement follows a period of speculation about when the draw would occur, as UEFA’s calendar is packed with domestic leagues and other international fixtures. Officials emphasized that the early March slot gives national teams ample time to prepare, scout opponents, and finalize squad selections.

## Why it matters
- **Barcelona’s qualification window**: With the draw set, Barça’s national team can now map out potential group opponents. If Spain faces a strong group, it could push the club’s star players to focus more on national duty, impacting La Liga schedules and club performance.
- **Player workload and rotation**: The timing of the draw influences squad rotation strategies. Players like Pedri and Riquelme may be rested in early league matches if Spain’s qualifying path looks tough, allowing them to peak for the Euro.
- **Transfer market implications**: Clubs often adjust transfer targets based on international commitments. A congested Euro qualifying schedule may lead Barcelona to seek defensive reinforcements to cover for players called up, affecting the summer transfer window.

## What's next
Barcelona fans should keep an eye on the official UEFA draw livestream on 12 March. Watch for Spain’s group placement and note the potential clashes with key club fixtures. If Spain lands in a group with powerhouse teams, the club may need to strategise squad depth ahead of the 2025–26 season. Stay tuned for post-draw analysis on how the draw will shape both the national squad and Barcelona’s tactical plans.
